content.short: MagicBlock's Ephemeral Rollups give Solana games and apps real-time speed while staying composable with the rest of Solana.
content.description: Some apps, such as fully onchain games, need faster updates than any base layer can provide. MagicBlock lets a Solana program move its state into an Ephemeral Rollup for a session, process updates there at very low latency, and then commit the result back to Solana, where it stays composable with other programs. Developers build with the BOLT framework and a Unity SDK. Beyond gaming, it now targets trading, privacy, DePIN and consumer apps, and runs the Magic Incubator for teams building on its engine.
